Garments: Oversized chocolate short-sleeve polo over ivory long-sleeve crew-neck shirt with pushed cuffs, faded olive knee-length utility shorts with large front patch pockets. No unshown shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: One slim polished silver chain bracelet. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved hollow garment ensemble. Preserve its EXACT clothing, layering, silhouette, colors, shoes and material. Input image 2 is original styling reference, ONLY for the accessories listed below. Create one complete styled outfit on a pure uniform WHITE seamless background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light, full uncropped framing. Add ONLY these 1 listed accessories, no other objects: 1. One slim polished silver chain bracelet. Attach those listed accessories naturally to the garment at realistic scale where possible; otherwise display the small listed object neatly adjacent. STRICT: do NOT add any unlisted hat, cap, eyeglasses, sunglasses, handbag, belt, jewelry, props or footwear. No person, skin, body parts, head, face, hands, visible mannequin, stand, text captions or watermark. Empty neckline and sleeves.
